service_boundary: Represents the Martian routing gateway, not the operator's research work or the separately branded optimisation product sold under another name.
regional_controls: No customer control over processing geography is documented.
retention_controls: The terms grant the operator a sublicensable right to use customer materials, defined to include all input data, for purposes that expressly include training and improving the operator's own machine-learning models. No retention period is stated.
routing: Requests reach named models through one compatible endpoint; a separately branded endpoint applies inference-time optimisation to frontier models.
customization: Inference-time optimisation is sold as a distinct endpoint rather than as customer fine-tuning.
strengths: Inference-time optimisation is offered as a product with a stated quality commitment, which is a different proposition from routing alone.
The gateway exposes both compatible request formats and publishes a public model listing without requiring a key.
tradeoffs: The terms expressly license the operator to train its own models on customer inputs, which is the opposite of the default among comparable services.
The pricing page the operator's own contract cites does not exist, so the fee model cannot be established from published documents.
The product has been repositioned twice and now sits alongside a separately branded successor, leaving the durable boundary unclear.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the upstream model appears in the endpoints reference or elsewhere in the API documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Martian API reference, endpoints page, for Martian Gateway

upstream_disclosure.note: The models page says only that "Martian Gateway supports 200+ models across major providers." and names no provider; no privacy or sub-processor page names the parties that receive request content.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Martian API reference, models page, for Martian Gateway

credential_handling.note: The documentation offers no customer-supplied-key path: the authentication page documents only a Martian-issued key ("Store your API key in environment variables or a secure secrets management system.").
credential_handling.scope: Martian API reference, authentication page, for Martian Gateway

cache_isolation.note: No prompt-caching behaviour or cache scope is described in the advanced-usage page or elsewhere in the API reference.
cache_isolation.scope: Martian API reference, advanced page, for Martian Gateway

vulnerability_disclosure.note: The privacy policy names no security contact or disclosure route, and no security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Martian privacy policy, for Martian Gateway

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named on the site or in the documentation.
